correctness.rationale: The bordered determinant gives 4|w|²(||z||²+|w|⁴), hence 4|w|² on the boundary, including the weak locus by continuity. With u=|w|⁴ the w-integral has density proportional to u^{mu+b/2-1}; the z-sphere integral contributes alpha! and the power (1-u)^(k+|alpha|-1). The beta integral gives the claimed norm, and the multinomial sum over alpha yields the kernel series using the principal branch. The ball inequality gives |U|<1, so the diagonal series also guarantees bounded interior evaluation. Conversely z=zeta=0 and |w|=|eta|=sqrt(|U|) realize the whole disk. Finite differences give P_n without truncation. Exact independent rational reproduction matched every frozen sign column: all positive for n=2–10 and ++++++-++++ for n=11, with regular nonzero pivots; the Cayley map therefore gives precisely two open disk roots in dimension 11, counted with multiplicity. Alternating coefficient signs exclude real negative disk roots and the positive series excludes nonnegative ones. Conjugacy and total multiplicity two imply simplicity. No claim is made for higher dimensions.
